parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description: The ID issued by IoT Platform for the device. This is the unique identifier of the device. You can call [QuerySpeechDevice](~~280408~~) to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

You must specify the instance ID. Otherwise, the call fails. You can view your instance ID on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.
><notice>
If no ID is available for the public instance, refer to [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).
></notice>
